== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Wess Victory, Star Trek CCG Top 12, continues the tradition of awesome play by Tennesseeans." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
